### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory containing hic output (compartments/, contact_maps/, distance_decay/, fastqc/, hicpro/stats/, tads/, pipeline_info/) plus the reprocessed multiqc/multiqc_data/multiqc.parquet. |
| `GENOME` | — | UCSC name of the assembly the run was mapped to (hg38, hg19, mm10, mm39, ...). Lays out the genomic axis of the Contact maps tracks; pass the UCSC spelling, not an iGenomes key such as GRCm38. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`cooler/contact_matrix.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cooler/contact_matrix.py) | Binned intra-chromosomal contact matrix, from a cooler dump joined to its bins. | `sample`, `resolution`, `chrom1`, `start1`, `end1`, `chrom2`, `start2`, `end2`, `count` |
| [`cooltools/distance_profile.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cooltools/distance_profile.py) | P(s): contact probability against genomic distance, per chromosome and pooled. | `sample`, `resolution`, `chrom`, `distance`, `contact_probability`, `log10_slope`, `observed`, `n_possible` |
| [`cooltools/domains.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cooltools/domains.py) | TAD intervals derived from the insulation track's boundary calls. | `sample`, `resolution`, `window`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `size`, `size_kb`, `n_bins`, `valid_fraction`, `region`, `left_boundary_strength`, `right_boundary_strength` |
| [`cooltools/eigenvalues.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cooltools/eigenvalues.py) | A/B compartment eigenvalues, one row per chromosome. | `sample`, `resolution`, `chrom`, `eigval1`, `eigval2`, `eigval3` |
| [`cooltools/eigenvector.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cooltools/eigenvector.py) | A/B compartment eigenvector track, one row per genomic bin. | `sample`, `resolution`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `weight`, `E1`, `compartment`, `E2`, `E3` |
| [`cooltools/insulation.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cooltools/insulation.py) | TAD insulation score and boundary calls, one row per genomic bin per window. | `sample`, `resolution`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `region`, `is_bad_bin`, `window`, `log2_insulation_score`, `n_valid_pixels`, `boundary_strength`, `is_boundary` |
| [`hicexplorer/distance_decay.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hicexplorer/distance_decay.py) | Contact probability against genomic distance, one row per distance bin. | `sample`, `resolution`, `chromosome`, `distance`, `contacts`, `number_bins`, `scale_factor` |
| [`hicpro/pair_flow.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hicpro/pair_flow.py) | Where a Hi-C library's read pairs end up, one weighted row per fate. | `sample`, `mapping`, `filtering`, `contacts`, `pairs` |
| [`hicpro/pair_stats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/hicpro/pair_stats.py) | The HiC-Pro valid-pair funnel, one wide row per sample. | `sample`, `total_pairs`, `unmapped_pairs`, `low_qual_pairs`, `singleton_pairs`, `reported_pairs`, `valid_pairs`, `dangling_end_pairs`, `religation_pairs`, `self_circle_pairs`, `dumped_pairs`, `valid_pairs_rmdup`, `cis_pairs`, `trans_pairs`, `cis_short_range`, `cis_long_range`, `total_reads`, `mapped_r1`, `mapped_r2`, `trimmed_r1`, `trimmed_r2`, `mapping_rate_r1`, `mapping_rate_r2`, `low_qual_rate`, `valid_pair_rate`, `duplicate_rate`, `cis_ratio`, `trans_ratio`, `long_range_ratio` |
| [`nf-core/hic/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/hic/recipes/samples.py) | One row per Hi-C sample, from the samplesheet the pipeline validated. | `sample_id`, `n_libraries`, `single_end` |
